title: Radicals and Data: Simplifying Roots, Mean, Median, Box Plots | Algebra I, Unit 10 + Examples
description:
Simplify square roots, multiply, add and subtract radicals, then describe data with mean, median, range and IQR, spot outliers, and display data with dot plots, histograms and box plots. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
